featured_reviews.name: Ayman
featured_reviews.review_text:
Walking into my 10th Board exam, I felt zero pressure, and that’s entirely thanks to Jahangir Sir's Mathematics Tutorials. Even though the overall portion was incredibly vast, Jahangir Sir tackled it so systematically that we finished everything well in time with plenty of room for revision.
The discipline and support from both Jahangir Sir and Hardik Sir made the entire journey feel smooth and manageable.
The frequent tests kept me sharp, and the extra practice we did by solving other schools' prelim papers was a brilliant move. But the real "magic" was the 20 predicted papers Sir gave us, they nailed the paper pattern so accurately that there were no surprises on the big day. It's the best place if you want to actually enjoy Math while being fully prepared for the Boards!!

featured_reviews.name: Tejas Sundar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very great teachers!
I joined JMT in 10th and it was everything I could’ve hoped for and more. The teachers taught all the chapters and concepts very clearly. No matter how simple my doubts would be they would explain it again and again till I understood. Even when I would miss my class, they always made time for taking extra classes so that I don’t miss any concept. Jahangir sir’s book was very well structured, it had all types of questions, and for every chapter it had a formula sheet and recap at the start and many board questions at the end of the chapter. His website had hundreds of questions and solutions. Board questions, the questions in the books, all our school tests and prelims were also solved and uploaded and on top of that there’s the self study question bank for further practice. And his extensive videos on every chapter explaining every question served as last minute revision for the nights before all the exams. He conducted many class tests and solved many board papers after our portion was completed to make sure we were always focused, practicing and prepared. JMT was the reason I got a 100 in maths this year and I would recommend it to everyone, this is the best imaginable coaching for maths! Definitely join.

featured_reviews.name: Jigna ganatra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to express my sincere appreciation for the Jehangir sir maths classes where we enrolled for the test series. Initially, we had joined only for practice and evaluation, but the experience turned out to be much more enriching than expected.

The level of support provided throughout the test series was truly commendable. Every doubt, no matter how small, was addressed with patience and clarity. The faculty ensured that concepts were not just tested but properly understood, which made a significant difference in performance and confidence.

What stood out the most was the continuous guidance and personal attention given to students. Detailed analysis of tests, constructive feedback, and step-by-step explanations helped in identifying weak areas and improving them effectively. The teachers were always approachable and genuinely invested in the students’ progress.

The structured test series, combined with consistent motivation and academic support, created a very positive and encouraging learning environment. It did not feel like just a test series, but a complete learning support system.

Overall, it has been a highly satisfying and valuable experience. I would strongly recommend these classes to anyone looking not only for practice but also for proper guidance and improvement in mathematics.
